# M1 and M2 evidence obligations

**ID:** `mandate.evidence-obligations-m1-m2`
**Status:** `mandate`
**Depends on:** `mandate.milestone-order`, `mandate.binding-constraints`

M1 must prove complete stable frozen bindings; owner and port enforcement; separation of defects from modeled failure; deterministic forward ordering; presentation and wall-time inertness; immutable correction history; separate proposal, authority, execution, settlement, and observation stages; Rust-enforced Godot boundaries; attributable oracle comparison; exact checkpoint/resume; and production operation without network or runtime-model services.

Negative fixtures must fail for duplicate contracts, unresolved owners, missing handlers or witnesses, incompatible schemas, fidelity violations, wrong-owner writes, unknown ports, unit mismatch, ambiguous writes, prohibited phase feedback, impossible initialization, and accounting violations. Valid economic inability remains a typed witnessed result.

M2 must prove dated capacity reservation and single release; pure folder drafts and previews; atomic combined-slate admission without downstream guarantees; evidence-bounded routing; useful costed options at hard deadlines; a named chief whose succession preserves office records but not private cognition; authored option bindings whose cards match immediate mechanics; interruptions that preserve open-folder context; and a separate non-causal scorecard alongside the in-world no-verdict review.

Every claim is labeled inspected implementation or observed execution. A flag, diagram, untriggered path, mock echo, compiler-only check, or replay alone cannot prove a different layer's behavior.
